title: Write off an invoice
body:
Finance needs a way to write off invoices we will never collect.

Add `write_off(invoice_id)` to `parcelo/invoices.py`. It sets the invoice status to "written_off", stores the time of the write-off in a new `written_off_at` field on `Invoice` (in `parcelo/models.py`), and returns the amount that was written off.

Only open invoices can be written off.
